_readme: How each config section is written to the camera. Compare-CameraConfig.ps1 uses this to build
ready-to-run write commands. Filled in from the camera's web page code (write commands.md step 2).
user:     the login used to write (the guest login may only be allowed to read).
commands: one entry per write command, in the order to write them (get_system_conf always goes last).
command: the post_ command name, for example post_image_conf
section: the read section its values come from, for example get_image_conf
method:  POST (settings sent as form data) or GET (settings in the URL)
fields:  the setting names the web page sends, in its order. Leave out to send every setting
in the section except camera-specific ones (MAC, serial, license, firmware).
